tools.name: accelevents_list_attendees
tools.description: List the attendees of an event with ticket status, ticket type and check-in data, paged and searchable. Personal data: names and emails. Accelevents API: GET /rest/events/{eventurl}/staff/allAttendees.

tools.name: accelevents_get_ticket_sales
tools.description: Get the ticket sales data shown on the event dashboard (by default ticket types; ADDON details when asked). Accelevents API: GET /rest/host/event/{eventUrl}/performance/ticketing/sale.

tools.name: accelevents_check_recurring_event
tools.description: Check whether the event is a recurring event. Returns true or false. Accelevents API: GET /rest/host/event/{eventUrl}/ticketing/checkRecurring.

tools.name: accelevents_list_sessions
tools.description: List the sessions of an event (title, time, speakers, tracks, tags), paged and searchable. Accelevents API: GET /rest/host/event/{eventUrl}/session.

tools.name: accelevents_list_public_sessions
tools.description: List the sessions shown on the public display and portal pages, filtered by tag, track or format. Upcoming sessions by default. Accelevents API: GET /rest/events/{eventurl}/session/v2/get-all-sessions.

tools.name: accelevents_get_attendee_sessions
tools.description: Get all sessions one attendee can see for the event, by the attendee's user id. Accelevents API: GET /rest/host/event/{eventUrl}/attendee/user/{id}.

tools.name: accelevents_list_speakers
tools.description: List the speakers of an event (name, title, email, sessions), paged and searchable. Personal data: emails. Accelevents API: GET /rest/host/event/{eventUrl}/speaker.

tools.name: accelevents_create_speaker
tools.description: Create a speaker on the event. Adds a record that appears in the event's speaker list. Accelevents API: POST /rest/host/event/{eventUrl}/speaker.

tools.name: accelevents_remove_session_bookmark
tools.description: Unregister an attendee from a session, or remove the session from the attendee's bookmarks. Needs the session id and the attendee user id. Accelevents API: DELETE /rest/events/{eventurl}/user-session/register/event-ticket/{id}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: accelevents_list_attendees, accelevents_get_ticket_sales, accelevents_list_speakers, accelevents_create_speaker · Private data: accelevents_create_speaker · Public sink: accelevents_list_speakers, accelevents_create_speaker · Destructive: accelevents_list_public_sessions, accelevents_remove_session_bookmark.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: accelevents_list_attendees, accelevents_get_ticket_sales, accelevents_list_speakers, accelevents_create_speaker · Private data: accelevents_create_speaker · Public sink: accelevents_list_speakers, accelevents_create_speaker · Destructive: accelevents_list_public_sessions, accelevents_remove_session_bookmark

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
